ValidationRule.description: Target_Field__c must be populated for single-field input types (Text, Email, Phone, Number, Date, Dropdown, Checkbox, MultiCheckbox, TextArea). Address-type questions use Field_Bindings__c instead and may leave Target_Field__c blank.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISBLANK(Target_Field__c), OR( Input_Type__c = 'Text', Input_Type__c = 'Email', Input_Type__c = 'Phone', Input_Type__c = 'Number', Input_Type__c = 'Date', Input_Type__c = 'Dropdown', Input_Type__c = 'Checkbox', Input_Type__c = 'MultiCheckbox', Input_Type__c = 'TextArea' ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Target Field is required for single-field input types (Text, Email, Phone, Number, Date, Dropdown, Checkbox, MultiCheckbox, TextArea).
